user.title: Choose Pulse
user.description:
Select the Tibber Pulse to forward to Tibber Cloud. Only Pulse devices that have already sent a STATUS message are listed.

**Important:** If a Mosquitto bridge (or another broker bridge) to Tibber Cloud is already set up for this Pulse, remove it first. Both use the same client ID, so Tibber Cloud keeps disconnecting one of them.

credentials.title: Tibber Cloud certificates
credentials.description:
Forward data from Pulse {pulse} to Tibber Cloud. Copy the values from the Pulse setup page (the field names are in parentheses). The certificates are stored on this Home Assistant installation and the connection is tested before anything is saved.

**Important:** Remove any existing Mosquitto bridge for this Pulse first, otherwise Tibber Cloud disconnects one of the two connections.

data_description.certificate: Paste the full contents of the certificate field, including the -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- and -----END CERTIFICATE----- lines.
data_description.private_key: Paste the full contents of the private_key field, including the BEGIN and END lines.

advanced.name: Advanced settings
advanced.description: The defaults work for Tibber's standard setup. Only change them if you know you need to.

data_description.ca_cert: Leave empty to use the CA certificate that comes with the integration. Paste the ca_cert field only if you need a different one.
data_description.mqtt_topic: Topic the Pulse publishes on locally, forwarded to Tibber Cloud. The default is the same topic as locally.
data_description.mqtt_topic_sub: Topic Tibber Cloud sends firmware updates and commands on, forwarded to the Pulse.
data_description.mqtt_url: Host name of Tibber's AWS IoT endpoint.
data_description.mqtt_port: Port of Tibber's AWS IoT endpoint, normally 8883.
data_description.tls_version: TLS version used towards Tibber Cloud. The default is TLS 1.2.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tibber Cloud forwarding
reconfigure.description: Settings for Pulse {pulse}. Leave the certificate and private key empty to keep the stored ones. Fill in both (and the CA certificate if needed) to replace them. The connection is tested before anything is saved.

confirm.title: Finish unsupported meter capture
confirm.description:
More than half of the received messages from {device} could not be decoded. Raw capture was therefore enabled automatically and diagnostic data is now being collected.

You can help add support for this meter by creating a GitHub issue and attaching the raw capture file. Submitted captures are used to improve meter support and are added to the automated test suite to help prevent future regressions.

Please allow the capture file to collect data for a while before downloading it.

Note: If the download does not start when clicking the link, right-click the link and choose "Save link as..." or "Open link in new tab".

[Download raw capture]({download_url}) | [Documentation]({documentation_url}) | [Create GitHub issue]({issue_url})

Before continuing, make sure you have downloaded the latest raw capture and created a GitHub issue.

When you confirm, capture collection will stop and the local capture file will be permanently deleted.

confirm.title: Finish meter capture
confirm.description:
A raw capture for {device} is being collected and can be downloaded using the link below. The file will continue to be updated with new messages while collection is active.

Note: If the download does not start when clicking the link, right-click the link and choose "Save link as..." or "Open link in new tab".

{download_url} | {documentation_url} | {issue_url}

Before continuing, make sure you have downloaded the latest raw capture and created a GitHub issue.

When you confirm, capture collection will stop and the local capture file will be permanently deleted.

cloud_connection_unstable.title: Connection to Tibber Cloud for Pulse {device} keeps dropping

confirm.title: Restart forwarding
confirm.description:
The connection to Tibber Cloud for Pulse {device} has been lost several times in a short period. The most common cause is that a Mosquitto bridge (or another broker bridge) to Tibber Cloud is still running for this Pulse. Both use the same client ID, so Tibber Cloud keeps disconnecting one of them.

Remove the bridge from your broker configuration and restart the broker, then confirm here. Forwarding is restarted and this notice is removed.

credentials.title: Set up Tibber Cloud forwarding

Pulse {device} has been found. You can forward its data to Tibber Cloud so the Tibber app, firmware updates and Tibber cloud features keep working. Paste the certificate and private key from the Pulse setup page. They are tested before anything is saved.

**Important:** If a Mosquitto bridge (or another broker bridge) to Tibber Cloud is already set up for this Pulse, remove it first. If you do not want forwarding, choose Ignore and this notice will not come back.
